subject: Fiscal radar & decision calendar: FY28 targets and contingencies
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Fiscal radar & decision calendar: FY28 targets and contingencies

Team — kicking off FY28 planning from the leadership side. Attaching a short pack and a decision-calendar template to help us run consistent scenario reviews across PM, Eng, Sales and Finance. High-level asks below: 

1) Owners: please volunteer owners for Targets, Capacity/Cost Scenarios, Sales Bookings assumptions, and Risk Contingencies.
2) Dates: draft targets due JUNE 7; scenario sets (low/med/high) due JUNE 21; consolidated QBR deck ready for leadership review JULY 8.
3) Governance: we need a recurring 30–45m weekly slot for triage in June; propose Tuesdays 11am PT.

Attachments: FY28_planning_pack_v1.pdf, Decision_calendar_template.xlsx

This is intentionally tight — QBR calendar is fixed and we need 2 weeks for cross-functional validation. Please reply with owners and any blockers by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fiscal radar & decision calendar: FY28 targets and contingencies

Stephanie — thanks for pulling this together. Two quick items: 

- Can we add a governance matrix (decision rights + escalation path) to the pack? I'm attaching a draft: governance-proposal.docx. If we surface who signs off on tradeoffs (cost vs. performance), it will speed approvals.
- Resource assumptions: please include a baseline headcount/cost sheet in the next revision (we should be explicit about FTE vs. contractor delta in the low/mid/high scenarios).

I'll block the Tuesday 11am slot for June; if others are blocked, we'll find an alternate.

Vivek
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fiscal radar & decision calendar: FY28 targets and contingencies

Stephanie — I'll nominate Marissa to lead the capacity & ops scenarios (Marissa, are you ok taking this?). Marissa should work with Finance (cc: I'll loop them into a follow-up) and Solutions Engineering on utilization/throughput assumptions.

Two asks from my side:
- Sales booking cadence: we need Sales to provide a weekly conversion funnel snapshot (Jan–May) as the baseline for bookings scenarios.
- Cloud/marketplace credits: procurement wants visibility on any marketplace discounts or commitments that could materially change cost projections. Please flag any vendor negotiations.

Laura
Chief Revenue Officer

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fiscal radar & decision calendar: FY28 targets and contingencies

Adding a few specifics to the timeline and deliverables: 

- Scenario definitions: low = 65% growth vs FY27, med = 85% growth, high = 110% growth (we can tweak per BU). Please include token-level cost/unit assumptions and impact on gross margin.
- Deliverable format: three slides per scenario (key assumptions, financial run-rate, operational levers).
- I'll own the aggregation step for the leadership deck; need everyone's scenario slides by June 21 COB.

Attaching a skeleton CSV for scenario hypotheses: scenario-hypotheses.csv.

Jonas
Head of Strategy
Redwood Inference
(attachment: scenario-hypotheses.csv)
From: Natalie Rhodes <natalie@boardroomadvisors.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fiscal radar & decision calendar: FY28 targets and contingencies

Thanks for including Boardroom Advisors on this thread — quick note from the market advisory side: two signals we've seen that may affect the med/high split:

- Enterprise buyers are accelerating due to cost-control initiatives; larger deals are now favoring multi-year, committed pricing (could impact bookings timing).
- Managed/private deployments still carry a 2–3x procurement lead time in regulated verticals — factor that into capacity lead times for private deployments.

If useful, I can run a short 30-minute session with your Sales & Strategy leads tomorrow at 10am PT to validate the funnel assumptions. Happy to join the governance call pattern you set.

Best,
Natalie Rhodes
Director, Market Insights
Boardroom Advisors

Quick wrap to capture owners and next steps (thanks everyone):

- Targets (sales bookings): Laura -> Sales weekly funnel snapshot (owner: Laura / Sales ops) — due JUNE 7.
- Capacity & ops scenarios: Marissa -> lead (Marissa to coordinate with Finance & SE) — scenario slides due JUNE 21.
- Aggregation & deck: Jonas -> compile leadership deck — first pass JULY 1, final for review JULY 8.
- Governance & escalations: Vivek -> finalize decision matrix (Vivek to send final doc).
- External market signals: Natalie -> will run a 30min validation tomorrow 10am PT if we confirm; thanks for offering.

Please confirm you're aligned on owners/timeline or suggest alternate owners by EOD tomorrow. I'll update the Drive folder (linked) and share the calendar invite for the weekly June triage slot.
